Handed to the team · lost-package claim on a delivered parcel; replacement/money is not mine to move

Sorry, that's frustrating. Marked delivered and never there means a carrier loss, so we open a claim with ShipBob and sort you out from our side.

One thing that helps: check with anyone else at the address and look around the property, since ShipBob sometimes scans early or leaves it out of sight.

I've pinged Abel and Georges on this now. Stay in the chat and one of them will jump in here, and if you step away the answer comes to your email.
please open a claim

That's done, the claim is with the team as of now and Abel or Georges are on it. Nothing more for you to file.

They'll confirm here in the chat, or by email to (email hidden) if you've stepped away. Anything else I can check on the order while you're here?
how do I file a claim

You don't file anything. We raise it with the carrier ourselves, and that's already in motion on Shop····.

Your part is just this chat. If anything turns up at the address in the meantime, tell us here so we can close it out.

The team confirms the outcome here or by email.
how long does this process take

I don't want to give you a number I can't stand behind, so I'd rather not guess at the carrier's side of it.

What I can tell you: Abel or Georges pick this up today, during team hours, and they'll tell you the timeline and what you get, replacement or credit, when they come back to you here or by email.
